kinds.d: Washing machine with a horizontal drum loaded through a front door; the standard type in Europe and most of the world.

kinds.a: top loader · pulsator washer · HE top-loader
kinds.d: Washer loaded through a lid on top; clothes are moved by a central agitator or a low impeller disc. Dominant in North America, Australasia and Asia.

kinds.a: washer dryer combo · all-in-one washer dryer · combi washer dryer
kinds.d: Single-drum machine that washes and then dries the same load; condenser or heat-pump drying, usually ventless.

kinds.a: laundry center · stacked washer-dryer · unitized washer dryer · wash tower
kinds.d: Washer and dryer built as one stacked appliance with a single control panel; mainly a North American format.

kinds.a: mini washing machine · portable washer · pedestal washer · countertop washer · 24-inch compact washer
kinds.d: Small-capacity washer for flats, caravans or small loads: 24-inch compact front-loaders, portable top-loaders on castors, pedestal drawer washers and hand-powered countertop washers.
t: pedestal washer under a main washer
m: 2.8 cu ft Portable Top Loading Washer

kinds.a: 2槽式洗濯機 · twin tub · semi-automatic washer
kinds.d: Washing machine with two tubs, a larger wash tub with an impeller and a smaller spin tub; semi-automatic and still common in Japan, Africa and South Asia.

notes: Tier shelf: six kinds, all carried over (Mini washing machine + Pedestal washer merged into Compact washing machine as the plan says). Kind sources: Wikipedia 'Washing machine' (covers twin-tub, top/front-load, laundry center) and 'Washer-dryer'; Compact kind uses the HGTV portable-washer guide.
